WhyUs.title: The shield we built is for defending your business
WhyUs.description: The Malibaan brand grew from one simple belief: financial justice is every business's right. That belief still runs through how we work with every client today.
WhyUs.reason1Description: No number is delivered without an explanation. Every financial report is explained in plain language, not just handed over as a spreadsheet.
WhyUs.reason2Description: Our advice is based on your business's long-term interests, not on selling more services — as we've shown in sensitive tax decisions.
WhyUs.reason3Title: A dedicated expert, not a support queue

WhyUs.reason4Title: Defense before tax and insurance authorities

ServiceDescriptions.accounting: Accounting and bookkeeping services for Iranian businesses — standardized chart of accounts, daily entries, and monthly management reports from a dedicated Malibaan expert.
ServiceDescriptions.tax-consulting: Tax consulting and filing of income and VAT returns, planning to legally reduce taxes, and defense before tax dispute boards with the Malibaan team.
ServiceDescriptions.vat: Registration and connection to the e-invoicing system, correctly issued e-invoices, and VAT return filing without penalties, implemented by Malibaan.
ServiceDescriptions.payroll: Payroll calculation, social insurance filings, workshop code registration, and project clearance certificates — Malibaan's personnel services for employers.
ServiceDescriptions.audit: Financial statement audit services and internal control implementation for companies raising capital, obtaining bank financing, or preparing for a tax review.
ServiceDescriptions.financial-consulting: Business plans, budgeting, financial statement analysis, company valuation, and outsourced CFO services — for data-driven financial decisions.
ServiceDescriptions.business-legal: Drafting and reviewing commercial and employment contracts, business legal advice, and pursuing registration disputes and claims — legal services that complement your accounting and tax needs.
ServiceDescriptions.digital-fintech: Implementing online accounting software, a reporting dashboard, automated e-invoicing, and payment/bank gateway integration — for digital financial management.
ServiceDescriptions.company-registration: Registering a joint-stock or limited-liability company, drafting articles of association, official gazette filing, and trademark registration with Malibaan — fast, legal, and rejection-free.
ServiceDescriptions.intellectual-property: Domestic and international (Madrid) trademark registration, patent and industrial design registration, name searches, and legal pursuit of trademark opposition — with Malibaan's advice.

About.title: An advisor who sits at your business's table, not behind an official form
About.description: Malibaan grew from one simple belief: every Iranian business, regardless of size, deserves precise, transparent, and independent financial advice.
About.storyTitle: From a small accounting office to the financial partner of hundreds of businesses
About.storyPara1: Malibaan started out advising a small number of small businesses — businesses worn down by scattered accountants, inconsistent reports, and unexpected tax and insurance penalties. They all shared one problem: the lack of a single, accountable team responsible for their business's entire financial cycle.
About.storyPara2: Today that team has grown into a group of accounting experts, tax advisors, and social-insurance specialists who together build one clear, unified financial path for clients — from the moment of incorporation to the annual audit. Malibaan's growth has always come through referrals from satisfied clients, not costly advertising, and that has kept our priority clear: quality of work, not volume of cases.
About.valuesTitle: Four principles that never get sacrificed under work pressure
About.value1Description: We explain every financial report in plain language — not just a numeric file only an accountant can understand.
About.value2Description: Our advice is based on your business's long-term interests, even when that means recommending fewer services.
About.value3Description: Every business is assigned one specific expert who knows your case from day one to today.
About.value4Description: We prepare documents and reports so they can be presented without worry in a tax, insurance, or audit inspection.
About.teamTitle: Experts who genuinely know your case
About.teamDescription: Our team is made up of accountants and tax advisors with years of hands-on experience across industries, and for more complex cases we work with certified court experts and independent auditors.
About.role1Description: Responsible for document entry, coding, and periodic financial reports.
About.role2Description: Responsible for return filing, insurance lists, and defense before review boards.
About.role3Description: Responsible for the legal process of incorporation, amendments, and IP registration.
About.role4Description: Collaborate with your team on audit and internal-control projects.

Consultation.title: 30 minutes that bring clarity to your business's finances
Consultation.description: Fill out the form below so one of Malibaan's experts can call you and schedule a free consultation about your business's accounting, tax, and insurance situation.
Consultation.expectationsTitle: An honest assessment, not a sales pitch
Consultation.expectation1Title: An impartial review of your current status
Consultation.expectation1Description: We review your books, returns, and current insurance filings to find risk points and opportunities to fix them.
Consultation.expectation2Description: If a penalty or inspection is coming, it can usually be spotted in advance. This first session surfaces the main red flags.
Consultation.expectation3Title: A practical path forward, not a sales package
Consultation.expectation3Description: If we find your need can be solved with a small internal fix, that's what we'll recommend — not necessarily long-term engagement.
Consultation.stepsTitle: From form to session, three simple steps
Consultation.step1Description: Write your name, phone number, and a short note about your business's needs; it takes less than two minutes.
Consultation.step2Title: An expert calls within one business day
Consultation.step2Description: One of Malibaan's experts calls you to schedule the time and format (in-person or online).
Consultation.step3Description: In a direct, no-obligation conversation, we review your business's status and give you a suggested path forward.
Consultation.directDescription: If you'd rather not fill out a form, you can also request your free consultation through any of the channels below.
Consultation.formDescription: Enter your name, phone number, and a short note about your needs; we'll call you within one business day.
Consultation.faqTitle: Questions people ask most before booking a consultation
Consultation.faq1Answer: Yes. The first consultation session is free for every business, with no obligation for further engagement. The goal of this session is to understand your needs and give you an honest assessment.
Consultation.faq2Question: How long is the session and how is it held?
Consultation.faq2Answer: Usually about 30 minutes — in person at Malibaan's office in Tehran, or online (phone or video call), whichever is more convenient for you.
Consultation.faq3Question: What documents do I need for the session?
Consultation.faq3Answer: Nothing specific is required. If you have your latest tax return, accounting books, or insurance list handy, bring them along, but their absence won't stop the session from happening.
Consultation.faq4Question: Am I obligated to continue after the consultation?
Consultation.faq4Answer: No. At the end of the session you'll receive a summary and a suggested path forward, and the decision to continue or not is entirely yours.

Privacy.title: Malibaan Privacy Policy
Privacy.description: Transparency isn't just in our financial reports — the same principle governs how we handle your information.
Privacy.s1Para1: Malibaan values the privacy of its clients and website visitors. This document explains what information we collect from you, why we collect it, and how it's protected. By using malibaan.com or submitting its forms, you agree to this policy.
Privacy.s2Para1: Two main categories of information are collected through the website and through working with Malibaan:
Privacy.s2List1: Initial contact information: your name, mobile number, and a brief description of your needs, when filling out the "Contact Us" or "Free Consultation" forms.
Privacy.s2List2: Financial and administrative information: once formal engagement begins, documents and information required to perform accounting, tax, insurance, or registration services, provided directly by you or your business representative.
Privacy.s3Para1: Your contact information is used only to respond to consultation requests and coordinate meetings. Contracted clients' financial and administrative information is used exclusively to perform the services agreed upon. Malibaan does not use your information for unsolicited advertising or bulk SMS/email campaigns.
Privacy.s4Para1: Access to each client's financial file is limited to the expert or team responsible for that file. Information is kept in internal systems with controlled access, and we apply standard security measures to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, or use.
Privacy.s5Para1: Malibaan does not sell client information to third parties or make it available to them for advertising purposes. The only exception is providing documents to official bodies (such as the tax authority or social security organization) as required by that business's legal obligations, and with the client's knowledge.
Privacy.s6Para1: The Malibaan website may use essential technical cookies for pages to function correctly. These cookies do not collect personally identifiable information and are used only to improve your browsing experience.
Privacy.s7Para1: You can request at any time that your contact information on file with us be corrected or deleted. Simply reach us through the contact channels below to do so.
Privacy.s8Para1: This policy may be updated from time to time. The date of the latest update is shown at the top of this page.
Privacy.s9Para1: For any question about this privacy policy, reach us via email at info@malibaan.com or phone at 0990-003-5009.

Terms.title: Terms of Use for Malibaan's Services
Terms.description: Reading these terms plainly and without ambiguity is part of the same transparency we pursue in our financial reports.
Terms.s1Para1: Using the malibaan.com website and requesting any of Malibaan's services means accepting these terms and conditions. If you disagree with any part of these terms, please raise it with our team before using the services.
Terms.s2Para1: Malibaan provides advisory and operational services in accounting, tax, social insurance, and company registration. These services are not a substitute for formal legal counsel from a licensed attorney, except where explicitly stated in a service agreement.
Terms.s3Para1: Malibaan commits to performing services with professional diligence, in accordance with current laws and regulations, within the agreed timeframe, and to maintaining full confidentiality of clients' financial and administrative information.
Terms.s4Para1: The client is obligated to provide the Malibaan team with accurate, complete information and documents needed for the services, in a timely manner. Delays or gaps in providing documents may affect the timeline or outcome of services (such as penalties from late return filing), and responsibility for that rests with the client.
Terms.s5Para1: Malibaan provides advice and services based on the best professional knowledge available, but final management and financial decisions rest with the client. Likewise, the definitive outcome of certain administrative or quasi-judicial processes (such as final rulings from tax or insurance dispute boards) is outside Malibaan's direct control, though our team stays beside the client through every stage of these processes.
Terms.s6Para1: All content on this website, including text, blog posts, design, and the "Malibaan" brand, belongs to this company. Using, copying, or republishing this content without written permission is not permitted.
Terms.s7Para1: These terms and conditions may be updated from time to time. The current version is always available on this page.
Terms.s8Para1: These terms, and any service agreement with Malibaan, are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
Terms.s9Para1: For any question about these terms and conditions, reach us via email at info@malibaan.com or phone at 0990-003-5009.
